entries.author: benstopics
entries.current_title: Show HN: I spent 3 years reverse-engineering a 40 yo stock market sim from 1986
entries.excerpt: Hello my name is Ben Ward for the past 3 years I have been remastering the financial game Wall Street Raider created by Michael Jenkins originally on DOS in 1986. It has been a rough journey but I finally see the light at the end of the tunnel. I just recently redid the website and thought maybe the full story of how this project came to be would interest you all. Thank you for reading.

entries.title: Show HN: Craftplan – I built my wife a production management tool for her bakery
entries.author: deofoo
entries.current_title: Show HN: Craftplan – I built my wife a production management tool for her bakery
entries.excerpt: My wife was planning to open a micro-bakery. We looked at production management software and it was all either expensive or way too generic. The actual workflows for a small-batch manufacturer aren't that complex, so I built one and open-sourced it. Craftplan handles recipes (versioned BOMs with cost rollups), inventory (lot traceability, demand forecasting, allergen tracking), orders, production batch planning, and purchasing. Built with Elixir, Ash Framework, Phoenix LiveVi
entries.guide_zh: 为妻子的微型面包房自建 Craftplan，用开源工具管理配方和生产流程。

entries.title: Show HN: NanoClaw – "Clawdbot" in 500 lines of TS with Apple container isolation
entries.author: jimminyx
entries.current_title: Show HN: NanoClaw – “Clawdbot” in 500 lines of TS with Apple container isolation
entries.excerpt: I’ve been running Clawdbot for the last couple weeks and have genuinely found it useful but running it scares the crap out of me. OpenClaw has 52+ modules and runs agents with near-unlimited permissions in a single Node process. NanoClaw is ~500 lines of core code, agents run in actual Apple containers with filesystem isolation. Each chat gets its own sandboxed context. This is not a swiss army knife. It’s built to match my exact needs. Fork it and make it yours.
entries.guide_zh: NanoClaw 用约五百行 TypeScript 核心代码配合 Apple 容器，隔离代理运行。

entries.current_title: Show HN: Algorithmically finding the longest line of sight on Earth
entries.excerpt: We're Tom and Ryan and we teamed up to build an algorithm with Rust and SIMD to exhaustively search for the longest line of sight on the planet. entries.title: Show HN: If you lose your memory, how to regain access to your computer?
entries.author: eljojo
entries.current_title: Show HN: If you lose your memory, how to regain access to your computer?
entries.excerpt: Due to bike-induced concussions, I've been worried for a while about losing my memory and not being able to log back in. I combined shamir secret sharing (hashicorp vault's implementation) with age-encryption, and packaged it using WASM for a neat in-browser offline UX. The idea is that if something happens to me, my friends and family would help me get back access to the data that matters most to me. 5 out of 7 friends need to agree for the vault to unlock. Try out the demo
entries.guide_zh: 担心脑震荡后忘记密码，作者把秘密分享与加密组合成离线账户恢复工具。
